title: Carrier quote
description: A carrier's normalized offer for one parcel: price, promised date, and expiry.

carrier.description: Carrier making the offer, as the gateway names it.

service-level.description: Normalized service class the quote is for, comparable across carriers.

quote-reference.description: Carrier's own quote id, quoted back on booking. Also records a gateway-supplied expiry.

price.description: All-in price in the carrier's billing currency. Equals base-rate plus every surcharge.

base-rate.description: Rate-card price before surcharges, in the same currency as price.

surcharges.description: Itemized additions. Base rate plus their sum equals price — a rule the gateway enforces.

collection-cutoff.description: Latest handover time for which this promised date still holds.

promised-delivery-at.description: Date the carrier commits to, and the only date a customer is ever told.

quote-expires-at.description: When the offer lapses. Required: a quote without a lifetime is a number acme invented.

surcharge.description: One named addition to the base rate — fuel, remote area, oversize, residential.

code.description: Acme's normalized surcharge code, not the carrier's label.

amount.description: Amount added, in the same currency as the price.
